stem: Which of the following is a recommended sleep hygiene practice?

options.text: Engaging in high-intensity exercise just before bed
Avoiding caffeine-containing drinks like coffee or cola after 2 p.m
Sleeping in late on weekends to make up for sleep debt
Using a screen in bed until falling asleep

explanation: Avoiding caffeine-containing drinks like coffee or cola after 2 p.m. is a recommended sleep hygiene practice because caffeine can interfere with falling asleep and maintaining sleep.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because vigorous exercise immediately before bed can make it harder to fall asleep.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because caffeine is a stimulant, and avoiding it after 2 p.m. helps reduce sleep disruption.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the bed should be associated with sleep rather than homework or other alerting activities.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because large changes in weekend sleep timing can disrupt the sleep–wake routine.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because screen use in bed can delay sleep onset and worsen sleep hygiene.

source.hint: Think about the specific time of day after which stimulants should be avoided.
